title: 7 Day Tanzania Fly-in Safari
rank_math_title: Tanzania Fly-in Safari: 7 Amazing Days with Ngorongoro
rank_math_desc: Tanzania fly-in safari for 7 days: Tarangire, Ngorongoro Crater and the Serengeti, with light-aircraft flights from Arusha and back. Price on request.
post_content: This Tanzania fly-in safari covers Tarangire, Ngorongoro Crater and the Serengeti, using flights to cut out the longest drives.
overview:
This Tanzania fly-in safari is a comfortable way to see the northern circuit. You fly from Arusha to Tarangire, drive through the highlands to Ngorongoro, then fly from the crater area to the Serengeti.

Flights replace the longest and roughest road sections, so you have more energy for game drives and more time in each park.

Why choose this Tanzania fly-in safari?

  • Tarangire: baobab trees and large elephant herds.
  • Ngorongoro Crater: a full day on the crater floor with lions and black rhinos.
  • Serengeti: three nights for big cats and the migration.
  • Less time on the road: short flights between the parks.

Where you stay

Tarangire Sopa Lodge, Ngorongoro Serena Safari Lodge and Serengeti Serena Safari Lodge, or similar.

Best time for a Tanzania fly-in safari

June to October is dry, with excellent game viewing in Tarangire and the Serengeti. December to March brings the calving season in the southern Serengeti.

Start with our shorter Serengeti fly-in safari, read our Tanzania parks guide or browse all flight packages. Park information is on the Tanzania National Parks website.

faq.q: How many flights are on the Tanzania fly-in safari?
faq.a: Usually three: Arusha to Tarangire, Lake Manyara airstrip to the Serengeti, and the Serengeti back to Arusha.

faq.q: How much luggage can I bring?
faq.a: Light aircraft usually allow 15 kg per person, including hand luggage, in soft bags without wheels. Ask us if you need extra space.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Fly from Arusha to Tarangire
itinerary.content: Short flight from Arusha to Tarangire. Game drive among the baobabs and elephant herds, then check in at Tarangire Sopa Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park
itinerary.content: Morning and afternoon game drives along the Tarangire River.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Tarangire to Ngorongoro
itinerary.content: Drive through Mto wa Mbu and up into the highlands to Ngorongoro Serena Safari Lodge on the crater rim.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.content: Descend into the crater for a full day of game viewing, with lions, black rhinos, flamingos and buffaloes.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Fly to the Serengeti
itinerary.content: Drive to the Lake Manyara airstrip and fly to the central Serengeti. Afternoon game drive and check-in at Serengeti Serena Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Serengeti National Park
itinerary.content: A full day of game drives with a picnic lunch.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Fly back to Arusha
itinerary.content: Early game drive, then a flight back to Arusha.
